info.title: Water Supplies Department — List of Waterworks Installations
info.description: Deterministic derivative of retained native CSDI metadata. Read-only GET operations are selected only where native capabilities and protocol documentation support them. Publisher originals remain separate. Successful metadata retrieval does not prove current data-query success, complete response fields or all layer combinations.

get.description: Read-only GET query follows the source-advertised Query capability. One parameterized operation covers all queryable layers. Metadata field types are declared without inventing universally required attributes. Omitted f may produce the native REST default representation, which is not asserted as a JSON payload.

parameters.name: layerId
parameters.description: Published queryable layer or table. Values are publisher identifiers; examples are choices, not a closed enumeration. The full ID/title directory is in x-csdi-layer-choices.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: Advertised query representation. Supply this selector for the represented JSON/GeoJSON/PBF responses.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: SQL WHERE expression over the published fields; source protocol supports this read-only query filter.

parameters.name: outFields
parameters.description: Comma-separated source field names, or *. Field schemas are conditional on the selected layer and returned fields.

parameters.name: returnGeometry
parameters.description: Whether native feature geometry should be included.

parameters.name: resultRecordCount
parameters.description: Bound returned records where the selected layer advertises pagination; no global range is inferred.

200.description: Native publisher response; protocol or business errors may also be returned. Metadata connection and actual data-query success are separate.

get.description: One read-only GET operation selects published feature types by name. Attribute types derive from retained DescribeFeatureType XSD when available; missing XSD, geometry, unread response data and unknown fields remain explicit limitations.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: OGC service identifier.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Exact capabilities version.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Read-only operation advertised by GetCapabilities.

parameters.name: typeNames
parameters.description: Published feature type names; multiple selections follow the advertised protocol syntax. Values are publisher identifiers; examples are choices, not a closed enumeration. The full ID/title directory is in x-csdi-layer-choices.

parameters.name: outputFormat
parameters.description: Advertised native representation; JSON, GML, CSV and images are kept distinct.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: OGC bounded feature limit; example requests one feature without claiming a server-wide bound.

parameters.name: srsName
parameters.description: Output CRS choices advertised by at least one feature type; support may vary by selected type.

200.description: Native publisher response; protocol or business errors may also be returned. Metadata connection and actual data-query success are separate.

schema.description: Native Geopackage+ZIP output; wire media type/fields are not constrained.
Native CSV; row/column wire conformance is not inferred from JSON schemas.

get.description: Map rendering returns its advertised native image/document representation. It does not return a feature JSON collection. Layer CRS, style and bounding-box choices are retained; no data observation is implied by metadata availability.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: OGC service identifier.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Exact advertised WMS version.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Read-only GetMap operation.

parameters.name: layers
parameters.description: Comma-separated published map layer names. Values are publisher identifiers; examples are choices, not a closed enumeration. The full ID/title directory is in x-csdi-layer-choices.

parameters.name: styles
parameters.description: Comma-separated style names; an empty string selects the standard default style.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Advertised GetMap representation.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Requested image width in pixels; no invented maximum.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Requested image height in pixels; no invented maximum.

parameters.name: crs
parameters.description: Advertised coordinate reference system; support depends on selected layer. Observe the WMS version and CRS axis order.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: minx,miny,maxx,maxy in the chosen CRS and its specified axis order. Example, when present, is an actual advertised bounding box.

200.description: Native publisher response; protocol or business errors may also be returned. Metadata connection and actual data-query success are separate.
